First Session / Intake Alignment completed with [Client]. 
- Wellbeing/Sobriety: [Client] reports he is doing well; did not take Suboxone today and is actively utilizing the support of his Turn12 sober living peers. Reports feeling encouraged by having a community of peers in similar circumstances. 
- Goals: Expressed a strong desire for a 'career, not just jobs.' Wants to obtain his GED and CDL. 
- Briefcase/Gate 2 (DMV/DL): Identified that he needs to clear up his license. 
- CBT/Motivation: Connected his successful grit in maintaining 1-year of sobriety to the consistency he will need to pass his GED. Discussed identifying mental/physical warning signs that precede relapse or walking away from responsibilities. 
- Action Plan for Next Week: 1) [Client] will visit the SC DMV to get a printout/estimate of what is required to reinstate his license. 2) Continue attending sobriety meetings.
Called and scheduled him for orientation on Friday 10/23 at 3pm.

- history of meth addiction, is currently living at Turn12 sober living, reports being sober about a year
- not sure of exact release date, "a couple of months ago"
- experience with forklift and heavy equipment but since expired
